### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: E&F's own common/scripted_triggers/00_ef_custom_trigger.txt.
### The trigger lists every currency good by key, and the ones we remove would be
### unresolvable references. local_currency is deliberately NOT added: the trigger
### hides currencies from the ordinary market list, and local_currency belongs there.
###
### REPLACE_OR_CREATE: is what makes this override at all. Without it E&F's
### original 95-good list stayed live and its market GUI logged ~12,000 script
### errors in two seconds -- see the note next to OVERRIDE in the generator.

	OR = {
		goods = g:spe_uni_c
	}
}
